comparison.objective: Place two setting blocks and stand a glass unit on them without touching the sill; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record positions supports, then bimanually lowers and releases a large fragile pane. Candidate keeps a service jig flush and parallel while sliding a small bearing block across a continuous support interface.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires correct block locations, glass seating, no sill contact and released stability. Candidate requires complete transfer, every ball retained and no gap, jam, impact, contamination or unsafe inclination.
comparison.reason: Both use supports to prevent damage, but glazing tests placement of a fragile panel onto discrete blocks, not preservation of a rolling-element raceway during transfer.
